scripts.db:local:reset: npm --prefix apps/api run env:local:check && npx supabase db reset
scripts.db:qa:preflight: npm run db:qa:check && npx supabase db push --dry-run
scripts.db:qa:push: npm run db:qa:check && npx supabase db push
scripts.db:local:rebuild: npm run db:local:reset && npm run db:local:bootstrap
scripts.quality: npm run api:typecheck && npm run api:test && npm run web:lint && npm run web:build:ci
scripts.db:beta:preflight: npm run db:beta:check && node --env-file=apps/api/.env.beta scripts/run-supabase-db-push.cjs beta --dry-run
scripts.db:beta:push: npm run db:beta:check && node --env-file=apps/api/.env.beta scripts/run-supabase-db-push.cjs beta
